title: Measuring Online Hate on 4chan using Pre-trained Deep Learning Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the prevalence of online hate speech directed at different groups, including religious groups, on 4chan's /pol/ board. This included classifying posts into a 'Religious Hate' category and analyzing the associated topics and toxicity.
findings: Religious hate was the second most prevalent category of hate speech identified, accounting for 23.36% of all hateful messages. Topic modeling revealed this hate was predominantly directed towards Jewish and Muslim communities, using specific slurs and aggressive language. Posts classified as religious hate also had a relatively high occurrence of identity attacks (3.30%) compared to other hate categories.
